notes.TWN: CRU TS 的全島面積平均：2025 年 1,972 mm（1991–2020 年平均 2,120 mm 的 93%）。中央氣象署 11 個平地測站平均 2025 年 2,500.5 mm（氣候值 2,161 mm 的 116%）、2024 年 2,135.9 mm。CRU 在台灣周圍 450 km 內用到的雨量測站 2014 年起從 8 站以上減到 3–4 站，近年的逐年變化跟氣象署差距較大（2025 年一個偏少、一個偏多）

notesEn.NOR: Norway on this map includes Svalbard (77–81° N), which is very dry, so it gets less than the mainland alone: 1,000 mm on average over 1991–2020, 11% below the 1,123 mm from the World Bank Climate Change Knowledge Portal (CCKP; also CRU TS, mainland only)
notesEn.TWN: CRU TS island-wide area average: 1,972 mm in 2025 (93% of the 1991–2020 average of 2,120 mm). The Central Weather Administration's 11 lowland stations averaged 2,500.5 mm in 2025 (116% of the 2,161 mm normal) and 2,135.9 mm in 2024. Since 2014 CRU has used only 3–4 rain gauges within 450 km of Taiwan (8 or more before), so recent year-to-year changes differ more from the administration's (in 2025 one is below normal and the other above)
